body:
## Summary

Fixes #39 by choosing the issue's **"Not meant for crates.io"** option: every Rust workspace crate now has `publish = false`.

| Crate | What it is | Why it's not on crates.io |
|---|---|---|
| `meta-sovereign-server` | The app's pure-Rust HTTP/WebSocket/WebRTC-signalling server (binary `meta-sovereign-rs`) | It's an application. The README runs it from a clone with `cargo run ... -p meta-sovereign-server -- serve`, and the desktop app ships the server inside it. |
| `meta-sovereign-wasm` | `cdylib` WebAssembly build for the SPA's heavy browser-side work | A WASM build for this app, not a reusable library. |
| `meta-sovereign-core` | Types and codecs shared by the two crates above (a port of `js/src/`) | Only used inside this workspace through `path` dependencies. Publishing it alone would mean keeping up a public API nobody else uses. |

The npm package (`meta-sovereign`) stays the only thing published to a registry, through OIDC trusted publishing. The policy comment about OIDC-first with a `CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN` fallback only applies to crates that get published, so nothing here needs it. If one of these crates should go to crates.io later, flip its `publish` flag and add the trusted-publishing job described in the issue.

## Changes

- `rust/crates/*/Cargo.toml`: add `publish = false`.
- `rust/Cargo.toml`: the workspace comment now explains why (and lists `meta-sovereign-wasm`, which it didn't before).
- `js/tests/rust-crates-publish.test.js`: new guard test. It lists `rust/crates/` and fails if any crate's `[package]` table is missing `publish = false`, or if a crate is added or removed without updating the test.
- `.changeset/rust-crates-not-published.md`: patch changeset.

## How to reproduce / verify

Before this change, the new test failed:

```
Error: Expected ["meta-sovereign-core",null] to equal ["meta-sovereign-core","false"]
```

After it:

```
$ node --test js/tests/rust-crates-publish.test.js   # pass 1, fail 0
$ cargo metadata --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --format-version 1 --no-deps   # "publish": [] for all three crates
$ cargo publish --dry-run --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p meta-sovereign-core
error: `meta-sovereign-core` cannot be published.
```

Locally, `npm run check`, `npm test` (892 passed) and `cargo test --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --workspace` all pass.
title: fix(rust): mark meta-sovereign-core, -server and -wasm publish = false
